artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1746: The Temple of Minerva
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gourary
artworks.description: The image shows a classical temple structure. It features tall Corinthian columns supporting a circular base, intricate carvings, and sculptures of figures on the upper part of the building. There is a dome or cupola on top with additional sculptures. Soft clouds are seen in the background. Below the drawing, there is text related to the temple or event depicted.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1746: The Territories of the Kingdom of Naples
artworks.artist: Miguel de Sorellò after Francisco Preciado de la Vega (designer)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gourary
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural façade. It depicts a highly detailed and intricate architectural design featuring classical elements such as columns, arches, and sculptures integrated into a grand building facade. The central section of the building is adorned with statues set within niches and decorative relief sculptures, while figures of classical mythological characters and emblems are prominently displayed. The composition is symmetrical, with a sense of harmony created by the repeated use of columns and arches. At the top, there are artistic ornaments, including winged figures holding trumpets, a central coat of arms, and elaborate crown motifs. The lower section of the drawing includes some human figures that appear to be illustrating or interacting with the architectural structure, suggesting its monumental or celebratory nature. The detailed drawing is likely a design or illustration intended to convey the grandeur and artistic style of this architectural facade.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1773: The Preparation of Theriac in Venice
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Vasi after Giuseppe Palazzi (designer) and Paolo Posi (architect)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gourary
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The image shows a building resembling a grand altar or stage with columns, sculptures, and ornate urns. The central structure is elevated on a platform with stairs leading up to it, set against a sky filled with clouds. In the foreground, figures are engaged in various activities.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Peasant Carrying Firewood
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point of a forest path leading into dense woodland. Tall trees and foliage obscure the horizon, but some open sky is visible in the distance. A figure with a dog is walking along the path towards the woods. The painting style features detailed brushstrokes depicting leaves, branches, and the forest floor texture. The black and white color palette gives the image a classic, timeless quality, using tonal variations for depth. Figures and animals can be seen in the distance beyond the trees, hinting at a continuing landscape.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Dead Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a rural settlement, possibly an Italian village, with two figures interacting. One figure is seated on a log while the other stands holding a staff. The scene includes rustic, textured buildings, hills in the distance, and a prominent church with a dome and tower. The etching style features fine, detailed lines creating textures, notably in the foliage and architectural details. The color palette is predominantly sepia, giving an antiquated feel. Light clouds are visible in the sky.

artworks.title: Young Woman Holding a Parasol
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.3 x 11.3 cm (6 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a person's body in a standing position, leaning slightly against a balustrade or ledge. The figure's face features soft and subtle characteristics, and their hair is styled back. They are wearing a detailed dress with a modest neckline and long sleeves, holding a parasol on their shoulder. The background includes a large urn or decorative element on the ledge, surrounded by trees and brush.

artworks.title: The Star of Kings, a Night Piece
artworks.artist: Jan van de Velde II after Pieter Molijn
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 20.9 x 16.5 cm (8 1/4 x 6 1/2 in.)
sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 21.1 x 16.9 cm (8 5/16 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered near a doorway illuminated by a lantern. Their clothing suggests an earlier time period. In the background, a group is near a star-shaped object with tall buildings under a night sky. The chiaroscuro effect highlights the contrast between light and shadow, adding to the drama of the scene. The style is similar to Rembrandt's use of light and shadow in depicting human interaction and cultural settings.

artworks.title: God the Father Standing in Clouds Surrounded by Angels and Putti
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure with long hair and a beard, standing in a slightly reclined position with arms outstretched. The figure is dressed in a long robe, and is surrounded by several winged figures in various poses. The background of the image features sketchy outlines and a subtle wash, with additional winged figures or birds faintly visible in the upper corners.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Peasant Carrying Firewood
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a path. A person with a dog walks along the path. In the distance, a village and more trees are visible. The artwork is created using an etching technique with detailed brushstrokes, displaying intricate tree and foliage details. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on blue-toned paper. Shadows add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Convent Terrace
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed landscape with a view from an elevated position. A stately building with Gothic arches and a tall spire is on the right, accompanied by a row of trees lining a path. A river curves along the left side between rolling hills extending into the distance. The horizon is where the hills meet the sky, creating a serene backdrop. The building, trees, and landscapes are depicted with fine lines, resembling etching or engraving work. The monochromatic palette adds to the intricate details and timeless quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Rear View of the Convent with Waterfall
artworks.description: The image showcases a landscape seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint, offering a panoramic view of natural surroundings. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the composition with a distant structure, potentially a church, among trees. The piece is crafted with detailed brushstrokes depicting leaves and rocky terrain. The color scheme is predominantly black and white, accentuating contrast and depth. In the foreground, a rocky path leads to a stream winding through lush vegetation, while the background shows a gently rising landscape with trees and a faint building outline.

artworks.title: Entrance to the Convent Courtyard
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated perspective of a winding path leading towards an architectural structure resembling a castle or manor with a round tower. The horizon is obscured by trees and rising landscape, with a tower and a spire in the distant background. The scene is depicted in black and white, with detailed brushstrokes showing foliage and textures. There is a bench near a column under trees arching over the path, leading to structured elements beyond.

artworks.title: The Convent of Neuburg from Haarlass
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil river landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. The scene includes a river, hills, trees, a settlement, rocks, vegetation, and a person standing by the water. The artwork features detailed line work and shading to convey depth and texture in varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: View of the Convent of Neuberg from the Summit
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, looking across a valley nestled between rolling hills. At the center of the image, a cluster of buildings and a small church-like structure with a spire emerge from the wooded valley. The horizon is defined by a series of gentle hills, creating a boundary between the earth and sky. The artwork is a monochrome illustration with fine, detailed lines and crosshatching to depict texture and depth in the landscape and foliage. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow. The intricate line work captures the terrain, from rugged hills to the lush canopy of trees surrounding the buildings.

artworks.title: The Convent of Neuberg from Schlierbach
artworks.description: The image shows a river with a man fishing near two small boats on the rocky bank. Sparse vegetation and small rocks dot the river's edge. In the distance, there are two triangular-roofed houses, a church with a spire, and tall trees separating the buildings from rolling hills in the background. The horizon features softly shaded hills and ridges. The image is in a monochromatic palette with fine lines indicating precise brushwork or printmaking, capturing a structured landscape design.

artworks.title: Street Fight [recto]
artworks.medium: conté crayon, pastel, graphite, and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund

artworks.title: Society Ball [verso]
artworks.medium: charcoal and pastel on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dance scene. The drawing shows a lively gathering of people dancing together, with figures depicted in flowing motion. The individuals are elegantly dressed, with the women in colorful gowns and the men in formal suits. The color palette includes soft hues of pinks, blues, and yellows that suggest movement and energy. The lines are dynamic and fluid, capturing the rhythm of the dance, while the background has a subtle blur, emphasizing the focus on the dancers in the foreground. The overall composition conveys a sense of celebration and vitality.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with a Cigarette
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, in a slight three-quarter view with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has curly hair, a beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a suit and holding an object in his hand. The background is a dark gradient.

artworks.title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to block): 24.7 x 18.5 cm (9 3/4 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an elderly figure standing over a kneeling figure in a pastoral landscape. The scene depicts an interaction between the two central figures, with the standing figure having a long beard. The kneeling figure appears to be pleading or seeking mercy. The background shows a landscape with trees and houses, providing depth to the image. Architectural elements like arches and columns add complexity to the composition. The drawing shows strong and precise line work with detailed cross-hatching and shading, characteristic of woodcuts or engravings.

artworks.title: Cereris Bacchique Amicus (A Friend of Ceres and Bacchus)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated from the waist up. They have a round face with prominent cheeks and a cheerful expression. Their dark hair is mostly covered by an elaborate hat with feathers and a rosette. The person wears a detailed outfit with a jacket and a scarf or cravat. They hold a goblet in their right hand and a torch in their left hand. A large drum with drumsticks is partially visible at the bottom of the image. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Vauxhall Gardens shewing the Grand Walk at the Entrance of the Garden and the Orchestra with Musick Playing
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Müller after Samuel Wale
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with many people gathered in a park or promenade. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a wide perspective of the scene with a large architectural structure on the right side. The structure is set upon pillars and crowded with people. Trees frame the scene, leading towards the distant horizon. The trees are intricately detailed with fine lines. The artwork uses etching techniques with elaborate linework to depict texture and details of clothing and architecture. The color scheme is monochromatic. People are depicted engaging in various activities, dressed in period attire. The sky is textured with wispy clouds as a dynamic backdrop.

artworks.title: Vauxhall Gardens shewing the Grand Walk at the Entrance of the Garden and the Orchestra with Musick Playing
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Müller after Samuel Wale
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Vauxhall Gardens. The scene depicts a broad path lined with trees creating a canopy. A gazebo stands to the right, with musicians. The setting appears to be from the 18th century. The artwork is created using an etching technique, giving it a textured appearance. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown. Figures are depicted engaging in conversation and socializing.

artworks.title: Young Man Wearing a Fur Headdress with a Headband, Facing Right
artworks.creditLine: Gift (Partial and Promised) of Vivian S. and Marc H. Brodsky
artworks.description: The image shows the upper portion of a person's body, focusing on their head and shoulders. The person is positioned in a three-quarter view, with their head slightly inclined downward and turned towards the right side of the frame. They have a serene expression with detailed facial features. The individual has their hair pulled back and wears an elaborate hat with feathers and decorations. They are clad in what appears to be a heavy material like a cloak or draped garment, indicated by intricate folds. In the background, there is limited scenery, possibly implying an abstract setting. Text is visible in the upper right corner of the image, accompanied by a signature-like element.

artworks.title: Bird Girl, Sonia Gramatté (Vogelmädchen, Sonia Gramatté)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving, printed in blue
